title: Cursor Inbox độc lập

C01.expected: Reproduce list/message cursor collision and identify route/API boundary before code changes.
C01.observed: S01 captured the missing selected row after page-2 navigation; the preceding browser probe returned 422 INVALID_CURSOR when message cursor audit-message-100 reached listConversations.

C02.expected: Implement the Inbox UI and cursor ownership together without changing API contracts or scope keys.
C02.observed: InboxPage reads cursor for the root conversation list and listCursor on detail routes. detailHref preserves listCursor and clears a previous message cursor when changing conversation. List Pager and Toolbar clear/write only their configured cursor; message Pager retains cursor. The demo mock gained deterministic operation-scoped error injection for isolated panel tests.

C03.expected: Run targeted UI and architecture cases for independent pagination, query ownership, filters, draft, cursor identity, and scoped requests.
C03.observed: Six UI002 browser cases passed with 45 conversations and 105 messages. List/message requests use independent cursor values; filter in detail removes listCursor and retains message cursor; request keys and active shop scope remain separate; draft survives message paging; POST is observed once and send/refetch/resync keep both cursors.

C04.expected: Run regression coverage for desktop/mobile, deep-link refresh/Back, panel-specific error states, changed conversation, and changed shop.
C04.observed: All 20 tests in fe016.spec.ts and all 155 built-demo Chromium E2E tests passed. Deep link / refresh uses listCursor=cv1 and message cursor=m2; mobile Back restores cursor=cv1. List 503 leaves messages usable, and message 503 leaves list/conversation detail usable. Shop-second requests contain no shop-demo cursor or data.

C05.expected: Save UI and architecture evidence and record test scope, limitations, and current gate status.
C05.observed: This acceptance file, baseline record, six-case Playwright report, current verify log, FE016 log, and full E2E log are saved. Plan status/checkpoints were updated without editing frontend-progress.json, frontend-plan.json, product plan.json, progress.json, or tasks/T*.md.
